signal: Celigo was named 2025 Gartner Peer Insights Customers' Choice and a 2026 G2 Best Software winner, and launched its API Builder

email.body1:
Kaitlyn, saw Celigo landed the 2025 Gartner Customers' Choice and a 2026 G2 Best Software win, plus the API Builder launch.

That kind of recognition pulls in more inbound and target accounts than an SDR team can work, so the follow-up volume outruns the seats and good accounts age out. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top three target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.body2:
Kaitlyn, quick follow-up for Celigo.

With demand rising after the awards, the real limiter is usually response speed and follow-up depth per rep, not the size of the list. Tightening that is almost always the cheapest lift available before you spend on adding new seats.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three specific things I would change, and our best practices alone typically lift response rates 50-70 percent.
email.body3:
Kaitlyn, last bit of proof for Celigo.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Celigo reply rate likely compares to peer iPaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kaitlyn, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If clearing follow-up volume without adding seats is not a priority right now, no problem. Riding a wave of post-award demand is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an SDR motion? I will tailor it to Celigo either way.
